keyPoints.en: Primary: farming (oil palm, rubber, padi), mining (petroleum), forestry, fishing.
keyPoints.bm: Primer: pertanian (kelapa sawit, getah, padi), perlombongan (petroleum), perhutanan, perikanan.

keyPoints.en: Malaysia is the second largest palm oil producer; MADA is the main rice bowl.
keyPoints.bm: Malaysia pengeluar minyak sawit kedua terbesar; MADA jelapang padi utama.

keyPoints.en: Secondary: manufacturing adds value (electronics in Bayan Lepas, cars, palm oil refining).
keyPoints.bm: Sekunder: perkilangan menambah nilai (elektronik di Bayan Lepas, kereta, penapisan minyak sawit).

keyPoints.en: Location factors: raw materials, labour, transport, ports, markets.
keyPoints.bm: Faktor lokasi: bahan mentah, buruh, pengangkutan, pelabuhan, pasaran.

keyPoints.en: Tertiary: services — tourism, banking, transport, education, health.
keyPoints.bm: Tertier: perkhidmatan — pelancongan, perbankan, pengangkutan, pendidikan, kesihatan.

keyPoints.en: Ecotourism and heritage sites (Kinabalu Park, Gunung Mulu, Melaka & George Town).
keyPoints.bm: Eko-pelancongan dan tapak warisan (Taman Kinabalu, Gunung Mulu, Melaka & George Town).

tip.en: Ask "taking, making or serving?" to classify any activity.
tip.bm: Tanya "mengambil, membuat atau berkhidmat?" untuk mengelaskan sebarang kegiatan.
